exposure: Nurse- and midwife-led humanized/respectful delivery care model
outcome: Number of births attended at the birthing center
cohort: The study analyzed data related to women giving birth at a birthing center in the Angel Albino Corzo municipality of Chiapas, Mexico, between 2016 and 2022.
finding: The implemented nurse- and midwife-led respectful delivery care model led to an increase in births attended, improved respectful care indicators, and the absence of maternal deaths over a six-year period.
